purchases.title: Thomas Forsyth: The General Handychap Path to Sound Money
purchases.summary:
Thomas Forsyth is a London designer, maker, and engineer. His work spans the Saatchi Gallery, Glastonbury Festival, the Wall Street Journal's Apple Car, and a Star Wars K-2SO build for Silicon Valley Comic Con. He calls himself a general handychap.
In this episode, Bitcoin For The Arts founder Dion Wilson talks with Thomas about why he uses that name, the three times Bitcoin showed up before it clicked, and why sound money and sound craft share a backbone.

purchases.title: Fzero: The Artist Creates First
purchases.summary: Fzero is a designer, illustrator, node runner, and co-founder of Ninefold, the studio he runs with Ivy Lumi. Their line is "stories that make you build." He started by copying manga as a kid. He studied economics, finance, and marketing, then opened stores and ran the floor for big fashion brands. The work looked like a career. It did not feel like one. On December 25, still under 30 and home with his family, he had a stroke. He already knew Bitcoin. He had been stacking sats for years. The scare settled the question.
